etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from French cuisine (“cooking, culinary art, kitchen”), from Late Latin cocīna, from earlier coquīna. Doublet of kitchen.

definitions.definition: (countable, uncountable) A characteristic style of preparing food, often associated with a place of origin.
(uncountable) Synonym of culinary art: The art of preparing food, generally.
(countable, dated) A kitchen or cooking department.
